condition_definitions.withheld_pickup_triples: Generator-withheld agent-object-destination pickup triples. The training set contains the corresponding person-object pairs at other destinations, so this is not a true unseen-pair test.
condition_definitions.new_character_names: Standard stories with {'Lammy': 'Orion', 'Anneena': 'Bianca', 'Jade': 'Cyrus', 'Penguin': 'Della'}; the fixed output classes retain their original agent-slot meanings. All genuinely new word tokens map to <unk> for the transformer.
condition_definitions.distractors: A paired transformation of every standard story with one extra simulator-valid event proven not to change the queried carrier.

notes: Results were collected from the source files named below; no scores are inferred.
CSV values are preserved as text; JSON reports retain their original types.
Checkpoints, hidden vectors, and images are referenced, not embedded.
Use the recorded configuration to distinguish full runs from quick checks.
